lines.en: Morning has come to the forest village.
segs: Morning has come to the forest village.

lines.en: The turtle is plodding along on a walk. Tap the turtle!
Tap the turtle!
"Hi! I'm Turtle."
The hop-hop rabbit is here too. Tap the rabbit!
Tap the rabbit!
"Hi! I'm Rabbit, the hoppy one!"
segs: Hi! I'm Rabbit, the hoppy one!

lines.en: The rabbit said, "Hey, slowpoke! Want to race me?"
segs: Hey, slowpoke! Want to race me?

lines.en: The turtle gave a big smile. "Okay!"
segs: The turtle gave a big smile.

lines.en: "Let's ask our forest friends to cheer for us!"
segs: Let's ask our forest friends to cheer for us!

lines.en: The owl mail carrier brought the invitations.

lines.text: 문을 톡 두드려 봐요. 누가 나올까?
lines.en: Tap the door to knock. Who will come out?
segs: Tap the door to knock. Who will come out?

lines.en: Tap the next door too!
Tap the door to knock!

lines.text: 누구 목소리일까요? 둘 중에서 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Whose voice is it? Pick one of the two!
Did you hear that? Whose voice was it?
It's the duck! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the duck!
It's the cow! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the cow!
It's the pig! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the pig!
It's the puppy! Tap the sparkling friend!
It was the puppy!
The rooster, the sheep, and the cat got invitations too!
The animal friends gathered to cheer!
segs: The animal friends gathered to cheer!

lines.text: 친구들을 모두 톡톡 눌러 봐요! 벌떡 일어나 응원해요.
lines.en: Tap all the friends! They'll jump up and cheer.

lines.text: 아직 안 일어난 친구를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap a friend who hasn't stood up yet!
Wow, what a happy cheer!
Before the race, let's do warm-up exercises.
Tap the rabbit! Stretch those ears~
One more time! Tap the rabbit!
Now tap the turtle! Stretch that neck~
Tap the turtle too!
Wow, the turtle's neck stretched waaay long!
segs: Wow, the turtle's neck stretched waaay long!

lines.en: The raccoon referee brought a big drum.
Ready~ Tap the drum and they're off!
segs: Ready~ Tap the drum and they're off!

lines.en: Tap the big drum!

lines.text: 토끼는 쌩~ 거북이는 엉금 한 발!
lines.en: The rabbit zooms off~ The turtle takes one slow step!
segs: The rabbit zooms off~ The turtle takes one slow step!

lines.text: 여기는 경주 지도예요. 돌멩이, 개울, 언덕을 지나 깃발까지!
lines.en: This is the race map. Past the rocks, the stream, and the hill, all the way to the flag!

lines.text: 아래 막대를 보면 누가 앞서는지 알 수 있어요.
lines.en: Look at the bar below to see who is ahead.

lines.text: 토끼는 쌩쌩 달려요! 화면을 톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The rabbit zooms along! Tap the screen again and again!
segs: The rabbit zooms along! Tap the screen again and again!

lines.en: Tap the screen again and again!

lines.text: 금세 언덕 위 나무 그늘까지 왔어요.
lines.en: Soon the rabbit reached the shady tree on the hill.
Looking back... no turtle in sight!
segs: Looking back... no turtle in sight!

lines.en: "Yaaawn~ I can take a little nap~"
segs: Yaaawn~ I can take a little nap~

lines.en: Shall we help the rabbit sleep tight?
First, tap the leaf blanket!
Tap the leaf blanket!
Snuggle, snuggle~ The blanket is tucked in.
segs: Snuggle, snuggle~ The blanket is tucked in.

lines.text: 부엉이가 자장가를 불러 줘요. 잘 들어 봐요.
lines.en: The owl sings a lullaby. Listen carefully.
segs: The owl sings a lullaby. Listen carefully.

lines.text: 이번에는 부엉이를 꾹 누르고 있어 봐요. 자장가가 이어져요!
lines.en: Now press and hold the owl. The lullaby keeps going!
segs: Now press and hold the owl. The lullaby keeps going!

lines.text: 나무 위 부엉이를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the owl in the tree!

lines.text: 부엉 부엉~ 토끼 눈이 스르르 감겨요.
lines.en: Hoo hoo~ The rabbit's eyes slowly close.
segs: Hoo hoo~ The rabbit's eyes slowly close.

lines.text: 마지막으로 해님을 톡! 구름이 해를 가려 줘요.
lines.en: Last, tap the sun! A cloud covers the sun.
Tap the sun!
The rabbit fell fast asleep. Zzz.
segs: The rabbit fell fast asleep. Zzz.

lines.en: The cheering friends whisper, "Shh!" Quiet now~
The rabbit is dreaming. In the dream, the rabbit came in first!

lines.text: 상으로 커다란 당근을 받았어요. 당근을 톡!
lines.en: As a prize, the rabbit got a giant carrot. Tap the carrot!
Tap the giant carrot!
"Crunch! Mmm, yummy!"

lines.text: 하지만 진짜 토끼는 나무 아래에서 드르렁 쿨쿨~
lines.en: But the real rabbit is under the tree, snoring, zzz~
segs: But the real rabbit is under the tree, snoring, zzz~

lines.en: Meanwhile, what about the turtle? Plod, plod, walking along.

lines.text: 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 한 발 한 발 걸어요!
lines.en: Tap the screen to take one step at a time!
Tap the screen to plod along!

lines.text: 어? 커다란 돌멩이예요! 돌멩이를 톡 해서 넘어가요!
lines.en: Oh! A big rock! Tap the rock to climb over it!
Tap the rock!
Heave-ho! The turtle made it over the rock!
segs: The turtle made it over the rock!

lines.text: 앗, 개울이에요! 거북이는 헤엄을 잘 쳐요.
lines.en: Oh, a stream! The turtle is a good swimmer.
Tap the screen to swim!
The turtle crossed the stream with the fish!
Now there's a tall hill.

lines.text: 화면을 꾹 누르고 있으면 영차영차 올라가요!
lines.en: Press and hold the screen to climb up, heave-ho, heave-ho!
Press and hold the screen!
Heave-ho! The turtle reached the top of the hill.
segs: The turtle reached the top of the hill.

lines.text: 위에는 쿨쿨 자는 토끼, 아래에는 거북이!
lines.en: Up above, the rabbit sleeps. Down below, the turtle!
Shh, tiptoe past quietly~ sneak, sneak.
segs: Shh, tiptoe past quietly~ sneak, sneak.

lines.en: Wow, the turtle passed the rabbit!
segs: Wow, the turtle passed the rabbit!

lines.en: The sun is slowly setting.

lines.text: 닭을 톡 눌러서 토끼를 깨워 줄까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap the rooster to wake the rabbit?
Tap the rooster!
The rabbit jumped right up! "Oh no, I fell asleep!"
Look at the bar! The turtle is almost at the finish line!
segs: Look at the bar! The turtle is almost at the finish line!

lines.en: All the cheering friends stood up!

lines.text: 토끼가 쌩쌩 달려와요! 거북이는 딱 한 발 남았어요.
lines.en: The rabbit is zooming back! The turtle has just one step left.
segs: The rabbit is zooming back! The turtle has just one step left.

lines.en: Tap the turtle! One last step!

lines.text: 거북이를 톡 눌러서 마지막 한 발!
lines.en: Tap the turtle for one last step!

lines.text: 사진을 보니… 거북이 코끝이 먼저 닿았어요!
lines.en: Look at the photo... the turtle's nose touched first!
The turtle is number one!
It's the award ceremony! The cheering friends do the wave.

lines.text: 메달을 톡! 거북이 목에 걸어 줘요.
lines.en: Tap the medal! Hang it around the turtle's neck.
Tap the sparkly medal!
Sparkle, sparkle, a gold medal!
The rabbit came over and said,

lines.text: "축하해! 다음엔 나도 쉬지 않고 열심히 할게."
lines.en: "Congratulations! Next time I'll work hard and never stop to rest."
segs: Congratulations! Next time I'll work hard and never stop to rest.

lines.text: 거북이도 말했어요. "고마워! 우리 또 같이 달리자!"
lines.en: The turtle said, "Thank you! Let's race together again!"
segs: Thank you! Let's race together again!

lines.en: Night came. The forest party began!
segs: Night came. The forest party began!

lines.en: Listen first! It's a lively march.
segs: Listen first! It's a lively march.

lines.text: 이번에는 친구들을 톡톡 눌러서 같이 연주해요!
lines.en: Now tap the friends to play along together!
segs: Now tap the friends to play along together!

lines.en: Well done! Now play however you like!
segs: Well done! Now play however you like!

lines.en: Everyone had a happy party together.
segs: Everyone had a happy party together.

lines.text: 천천히 가도 끝까지 하면 해낼 수 있어요!
lines.en: Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
segs: Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
